verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party Realtime docs list Postgres Changes, which lets you listen to database changes in real time. The GitHub README lists Realtime subscriptions as an auto-generated API, and Broadcast is documented for pushing database changes to clients. Together these deliver live data subscriptions without polling. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of realtime delivery, detailed evidence on the client subscription API (filters, channel setup) and on authorization of realtime events.
